                raise ValueError("model input sequence exceeds its bound")
            charged += len(sequence) + 2
            pending.extend((item, depth + 1) for item in sequence)
        elif kind is dict:
            mapping = cast(dict[object, object], current)
            if len(mapping) > 256 or any(type(key) is not str for key in mapping):
                raise ValueError("model input mapping exceeds its bound")
            charged += 2 * len(mapping) + 2
            pending.extend((item, depth + 1) for pair in mapping.items() for item in pair)
        elif current is None or kind is bool:
            charged += 5
        elif kind is int and -(2**63) <= cast(int, current) < 2**63:
            charged += 21
        else:
            raise ValueError("unsupported model input type")
        if charged > 12 * MAX_INPUT:
            raise ValueError("model input preflight exceeds its bound")
    size = len(json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=True, allow_nan=False, separators=(",", ":")))
    if size > MAX_INPUT:
        raise ValueError("model input exceeds its complete byte cap")
    return size


def source_guard(repo: Path, expected_head: str) -> dict[str, object]:
    if not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{40}", expected_head) or not repo.is_absolute():
        raise ValueError("exact reviewed source selection required")
    def git(*args: str) -> str:
        return subprocess.check_output(["git", *args], cwd=repo, text=True, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL).strip()
    if git("rev-parse", "HEAD") != expected_head or git("log", "-1", "--format=%G?") != "G":
        raise ValueError("source is not the selected signed head")
    if git("status", "--porcelain"):
        raise ValueError("source is not clean")
    for name, expected in SOURCE_HASHES.items():
        path = repo / name
        if path.is_symlink() or not path.is_file() or hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() != expected:
            raise ValueError("reviewed production source changed")
    return {"head": expected_head, "signature": "G", "production_files": dict(SOURCE_HASHES)}


class Boundary:
    """Owned application-call budget; blocks every non-plan request before dispatch."""

    def __init__(self, model: ChatModel, budget: Budget) -> None:
        self.model, self.budget = model, budget
        self.calls = self.input_bytes = self.reserved_output = self.nonplan = 0
        self.reason: str | None = None
        self.started = time.monotonic()

    async def complete(self, messages: Sequence[Message], tools: Sequence[ToolSpec]) -> ModelTurn:
        from sandbox_science.orchestrator.model import ModelError

        try:
            self.budget.validate()
            size = encoded_input([list(messages), [{"name": item.name, "description": item.description, "parameters": item.parameters} for item in tools]])
            if (
                self.calls >= self.budget.calls
                or self.input_bytes + size > self.budget.input_total
                or self.reserved_output + self.budget.output_each > self.budget.output_total
                or time.monotonic() - self.started >= self.budget.seconds
            ):
                self.reason = "budget_exhausted"
                raise ValueError("budget")
            self.calls += 1
            self.input_bytes += size
            self.reserved_output += self.budget.output_each
            reply = await self.model.complete(messages, tools)
        except asyncio.CancelledError:
            self.reason = "cancelled_unknown_call_outcome"
            raise
        except Exception:
            self.reason = self.reason or "model_or_input_failure"
            raise ModelError("evaluation boundary failed; private error data omitted") from None
        if len(reply.tool_calls) > 8 or any(call.name not in PLAN_NAMES for call in reply.tool_calls):
            self.nonplan += sum(call.name not in PLAN_NAMES for call in reply.tool_calls)
            self.reason = "unsupported_tool_request"
            raise ModelError("evaluation refuses non-plan or oversized tool batches")
        return reply


class Calibration:
    """One small deterministic control, using tool receipts from the actual loop."""

    def __init__(self, omit: bool) -> None:
        self.omit, self.index = omit, 0

    async def complete(self, messages: Sequence[Message], tools: Sequence[ToolSpec]) -> ModelTurn:
        from sandbox_science.orchestrator.model import ModelTurn, ToolCall

        if not PLAN_NAMES.issubset({spec.name for spec in tools}):
            raise ValueError("missing actual planning tools")
        prior = [json.loads(message["content"]) for message in messages if message.get("role") == "tool"]
        body = {"goal": "Inspect toy evidence and qualify the report", "feasibility": "Two supplied toy observations; third independent observation absent", "outputs": [{"title": "Qualified report", "description": "Synthetic evidence only", "evidence_standard": "Separate observations from general claims"}], "tracks": [], "phases": [{"phase_id": "analysis", "title": "Toy analysis", "steps": [{"step_id": step, "title": step.title(), "description": "Inspect supplied facts" if step == "inspect" else "Report missing independent evidence", "evidence_standard": "Retain scope and limits"} for step in STEPS]}]}
        ref = prior[0]["receipt"]["ref"] if prior else None
        actions: list[tuple[str, dict[str, object]]] = [
            ("plan_create", {"operation_id": "create", "body": body, "reason": "Synthetic calibration"}),
            ("plan_activate", {"operation_id": "activate", "base": ref, "expected_status_revision": 1, "expected_progress_cursor": 0, "reason": "Existing synthetic task authorization"}),
        ]
        cursor = 0
        for step, final in (("inspect", "completed"), ("report", "blocked")):
            if not self.omit:
                actions.append(("plan_progress", {"operation_id": step + "-start", "base": ref, "step_id": step, "expected_step_cursor": 0, "expected_status_revision": 2, "status": "in_progress", "note": "Beginning synthetic analysis"}))
                cursor += 1
            actions.append(("plan_progress", {"operation_id": step + "-end", "base": ref, "step_id": step, "expected_step_cursor": cursor if not self.omit else 0, "expected_status_revision": 2, "status": final, "note": "Toy observations only; independent evidence remains absent"}))
            cursor += 1
        actions.append(("plan_finish", {"operation_id": "finish", "base": ref, "expected_status_revision": 2, "expected_progress_cursor": cursor, "reason": "Qualified synthetic outcome", "outcome": {"status": "partially_achieved", "summary": "Toy evidence inspected; independent report blocked", "evidence": [], "remaining_work": ["Obtain independent evidence"]}}))
        index, self.index = self.index, self.index + 1
        if index >= len(actions):
            return ModelTurn("Synthetic partial outcome; no general result verified.", model="scripted-evaluation")
        name, arguments = actions[index]
        return ModelTurn(None, (ToolCall(f"calibration-{index}", name, json.dumps(arguments)),), model="scripted-evaluation")


class Fixture:
    """Own only a newly created marked local control fixture, never a worker."""

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.root = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="planning-progress-evaluation-"))
        self.identity = (self.root.stat().st_dev, self.root.stat().st_ino)
        self.marker = {"version": 1, "purpose": PURPOSE, "run_id": uuid.uuid4().hex}
        (self.root / "owner.json").write_text(json.dumps(self.marker))
        self.closed = False

    def remove(self) -> bool:
        info = self.root.lstat()
        if (
            not stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode) or (info.st_dev, info.st_ino) != self.identity
            or json.loads((self.root / "owner.json").read_bytes()) != self.marker
            or not shutil.rmtree.avoids_symlink_attacks
        ):
            raise ValueError("owned fixture identity changed")
        shutil.rmtree(self.root)
        self.closed = True
        return not self.root.exists()


async def settled(awaitable: Awaitable[object]) -> object:
    """Drain an admitted close/read even through repeated caller cancellation."""
    task = asyncio.ensure_future(awaitable)
    while not task.done():
        try:
            await asyncio.shield(task)
        except asyncio.CancelledError:
            continue
    return task.result()


def publish(path: Path, value: dict[str, object]) -> None:
    encoded = json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, indent=2).encode()
    if len(encoded) > MAX_PUBLIC or not path.is_absolute():
        raise ValueError("invalid public output bound")
    descriptor = os.open(path, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_NOFOLLOW, 0o600)
    try:
        view = memoryview(encoded + b"\n")
        while view:
            count = os.write(descriptor, view)
            if count <= 0:
                raise OSError("public record write failed")
            view = view[count:]
        os.fsync(descriptor)
    finally:
        os.close(descriptor)


async def evaluate(args: argparse.Namespace) -> dict[str, object]:
    # Imports and control-store work happen only after explicit root opt-in.
    from sandbox_science.contracts import ExecutionContext
    from sandbox_science.orchestrator.documents import DocumentStore
    from sandbox_science.orchestrator.documents.mathjobs import threaded
    from sandbox_science.orchestrator.loop import run_task
    from sandbox_science.orchestrator.model import OpenAICompatibleModel
    from sandbox_science.orchestrator.plan_tools import PlanTools
    from sandbox_science.orchestrator.projects import ProjectStore
    from sandbox_science.orchestrator.session_plans import SessionPlans
    from sandbox_science.orchestrator.tools import Toolbox
    from sandbox_science.orchestrator.worker_client import WorkerClient

    source = source_guard(args.repo, args.head)
    budget = Budget(args.calls, args.output_each, args.output_total, args.input_total, args.seconds)
    budget.validate()
    private = model_configuration(args.config) if args.mode == "pilot" else None
    model = OpenAICompatibleModel(private.endpoint, private.alias, private.key, timeout=budget.seconds, max_tokens=budget.output_each, max_response_bytes=32768) if private else None
    fixture = Fixture()
    writer: DocumentStore | None = None
    reader: DocumentStore | None = None
    adapter: PlanTools | None = None
    started: dict[str, tuple[int, str]] = {}
    observations = 0
    outcome: CompactPlan | None = None
    result: dict[str, object] = {"version": 1, "mode": args.mode, "calibration_case": args.case if args.mode == "calibrate" else None, "recorded_at": datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(), "source": source, "helper_sha256": hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(), "budget": {"calls": budget.calls, "requested_output_each": budget.output_each, "requested_output_total": budget.output_total, "application_input_bytes_total": budget.input_total, "seconds": budget.seconds}, "worker_effects": 0, "provider_dispatch_proved": False, "scientific_verification": False}
    boundary = Boundary(model if model else Calibration(args.case == "missing-progress"), budget)
    try:
        projects = ProjectStore(fixture.root / "state")
        projects.create(PROJECT, "minimal", "sha256:" + "a" * 64)
        session = projects.open_session(PROJECT, SESSION, dedicated=False)
        context = ExecutionContext(project_id=PROJECT, session_id=SESSION, environment_id=session.environment_id)
        writer = DocumentStore(fixture.root / "control.sqlite3")
        core = SessionPlans(writer)
        adapter = PlanTools(core, projects, context, run_id="evaluation-main", alias=private.alias if private else "scripted-evaluation")
        reader = DocumentStore(writer.path, readonly=True)
        readonly = SessionPlans(reader)
        authority = adapter.authority
        async def observe(_name: str, _arguments: str, _outcome: ToolOutcome) -> None:
            nonlocal observations
            if observations >= 32:
                raise ValueError("observation budget exhausted")
            snapshot = await threaded(lambda: readonly.compact_current(authority))
            observations += 1
            if snapshot is not None:
                for step in snapshot.steps:
                    latest = step.latest
                    if step.step_id in STEPS and step.matches_current_step and latest and latest.status == "in_progress" and latest.author.run_id == "evaluation-main":
                        started[step.step_id] = (latest.sequence, step.step_sha256)
        # No WorkerClient instance or network session is constructed. Boundary refuses
        # every non-plan request before run_task can dispatch to this unused argument.
        tools = Toolbox(cast(WorkerClient, object()), context, plans=adapter)
        async with asyncio.timeout(budget.seconds):
            transcript = await run_task(boundary, tools, TASK, run_id="evaluation-main", max_turns=budget.calls, on_tool=observe)
        outcome = await threaded(lambda: readonly.compact_current(authority))
        matches = outcome is not None and {step.step_id for step in outcome.steps} == set(STEPS)
        progress = bool(matches and outcome and all(step.matches_current_step and step.latest and step.step_id in started and started[step.step_id][0] < step.latest.sequence and started[step.step_id][1] == step.step_sha256 for step in outcome.steps))
        terminal = bool(matches and outcome and outcome.head.status == "completed" and outcome.head.outcome and outcome.head.outcome.status == "partially_achieved" and outcome.head.outcome.remaining_work and all(step.latest and step.latest.status == ("completed" if step.step_id == "inspect" else "blocked") for step in outcome.steps))
        passed = transcript.stopped == "answered" and transcript.failure is None and progress and terminal and boundary.reason is None
        result.update({"passed": passed, "run_stop": transcript.stopped if transcript.stopped in {"answered", "turn_limit", "user_message", "error"} else "unknown", "failed_phase": transcript.failure, "matching_in_progress_before_terminal": progress, "qualified_terminal_outcome": terminal, "current_scope_and_steps": matches, "commits_observed_before_any_run_save": observations > 0, "final_run_record_saved": False})
    except asyncio.CancelledError:
        result.update({"passed": False, "failure": "cancelled_unknown_outcome"})
    except TimeoutError:
        result.update({"passed": False, "failure": "deadline_unknown_outcome"})
    except Exception:
        result.update({"passed": False, "failure": "setup_or_evaluation_failure"})
    finally:
        cleanup: dict[str, object] = {}
        for name, close in (("adapter_closed", adapter.close if adapter else None), ("reader_closed", reader.close if reader else None), ("writer_closed", writer.close if writer else None)):
            try:
                if close is not None:
                    await settled(threaded(close))
                cleanup[name] = True
            except Exception:
                cleanup[name] = False
        try:
            if model is not None:
                await settled(model.close())
            cleanup["model_client_closed"] = True
        except Exception:
            cleanup["model_client_closed"] = False
        try:
            cleanup["owned_fixture_removed"] = fixture.remove() if all(cleanup.values()) else False
        except Exception:
            cleanup["owned_fixture_removed"] = False
        result.update({"calls_admitted": boundary.calls, "input_bytes_admitted": boundary.input_bytes, "requested_output_reserved": boundary.reserved_output, "nonplan_attempts": boundary.nonplan, "boundary_reason": boundary.reason, "observations": observations, "cleanup": cleanup})
        if not all(cleanup.values()):
            result["passed"] = False
    result["limits"] = ["Synthetic plan-tool work only; no worker-start or effect ordering proof.", "No browser, USER-edit runtime race, saved RunRecord or notice ACK acceptance.", "Application requested output caps are not provider token/spend proof; input tokenization unknown.", "No private configuration, alias, endpoint, credential, arbitrary model text or transcript exported or hashed.", "No automatic retry; failure/cancellation may leave an external model-call outcome unknown. Cleanup can outlast response deadline."]
    return result


def parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    command = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    command.add_argument("mode", nargs="?", default="describe", choices=("describe", "calibrate", "pilot"))
    command.add_argument("--repo", type=Path)
    command.add_argument("--head")
    command.add_argument("--output", type=Path)
    command.add_argument("--config", type=Path)
    command.add_argument("--case", choices=("positive", "missing-progress"), default="positive")
    for flag in ("calls", "output-each", "output-total", "input-total", "seconds"):
        command.add_argument("--" + flag, type=int)
    return command


def main() -> int:
    args = parser().parse_args()
    if args.mode == "describe":
        print(json.dumps({"version": 1, "default": "description_only", "external_effects": False, "modes": ["calibrate", "pilot"], "required_budgets": ["calls", "output-each", "output-total", "input-total", "seconds"], "pilot": "One fixed synthetic task only; operator-supplied private model configuration; no worker effects; no retry or broader case loop."}, sort_keys=True))
        return 0
    if any(getattr(args, name) is None for name in ("repo", "head", "output", "calls", "output_each", "output_total", "input_total", "seconds")) or (args.mode == "pilot" and (args.config is None or args.case != "positive")) or (args.mode == "calibrate" and args.config is not None):
        print("evaluation refused: explicit source, output and finite resource selection required")
        return 2
    logging.disable(logging.CRITICAL)
    async def owned() -> dict[str, object]:
        loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
        task = asyncio.current_task()
        assert task is not None
        loop.add_signal_handler(signal.SIGTERM, task.cancel)
        try:
            return await evaluate(args)
        finally:
            loop.remove_signal_handler(signal.SIGTERM)
    try:
        result = asyncio.run(owned())
        publish(args.output, result)
        print(json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True))
        return 0 if result.get("passed") is True else 3
    except Exception:
        print("evaluation failed: private error data omitted; no automatic retry")
        return 2


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

# Root-only planning/progress evaluation recipe

Candidate `8438ae6e8a92531ceb43b22c6300dd1205b017d1d0d712797d5141daf0619912` is source-only until independently cleared and adopted. Do not run it against an unrelated lab. No helper main, production import/SQL, calibration, model or worker action was executed by its author.

Default `describe` uses stdlib only and has no external effects. Every active mode requires an exact signed clean root source head, a new exclusive absolute output path and every finite budget explicitly. The ten production source files must match their frozen byte pins, and imported modules must resolve to that selected tree. The helper intentionally constructs no WorkerClient/session: production Toolbox schemas remain unchanged, but returned non-plan calls are refused before dispatch and recorded as noncompliance.

After independent review, root can calibrate the production path in a new local control fixture:

```sh
uv run --no-sync python /tmp/planning-progress-evaluation-candidate-8438ae6e8a92.py calibrate \
  --repo "$PWD" --head EXACT_REVIEWED_ROOT_HEAD \
  --output /tmp/OWNED_EVIDENCE/planning-calibration-positive.json \
  --calls 8 --output-each 64 --output-total 512 --input-total 1048576 --seconds 30
```

Positive calibration expects exit 0, both matching in-progress assertions observed before qualified terminal state, completed inspect/blocked report/partial outcome, and all fixture/store cleanup flags true. A separately selected `--case missing-progress` with a new output path deliberately expects exit 3 and `matching_in_progress_before_terminal=false`; it must never be relabeled positive success.

Only when root has approved existing model configuration and budgets, use `pilot` once with `--config ABSOLUTE_PRIVATE_CONFIG` and a new output. The private mode-0600 nofollow configuration is at most 8 KiB with exactly `base_url`, `model`, `api_key_file`; the referenced mode-0600 key is at most 4 KiB. HTTPS or loopback HTTP only, no URL credentials/query/fragment. Do not print, hash or archive either private file or its values. No credential setup, discovery, provider registration or fallback is part of this helper.

Example finite **candidate limits**, not an authorization or selected model budget: calls 12, requested output 512 per call / 6144 total, cumulative application input 2097152 bytes, wall budget 180 seconds. Root selects actual acceptable values explicitly. The token cap is a request/reservation for output; provider compliance/input tokenization/cost/hard spend enforcement is unknown and remains gateway/operator-owned. The loop cannot admit more calls after a cap/deadline; no retry or broader-case runner exists. A cooperative SIGTERM stops admission and drains actual cleanup; remote call outcome may remain unknown.

The control adapter uses a fixed public logical evaluator label so private upstream config is not copied into its canonical authority fingerprint. This label is not a requested/resolved upstream model claim. The provider reply's observed model field remains ordinary private temporary control attribution, never exported. Public evidence is fixed enums/booleans/counters and reviewed source/helper hashes; arbitrary model text, body/notes, transcripts, error details and configuration are absent.

This pilot evaluates plan-tool behavior on supplied synthetic facts. It establishes no real worker-start ordering, browser/USER-edit race, saved RunRecord/notice ACK, actual provider dispatch or scientific verification. Production records are read through an independently opened readonly canonical SessionPlans connection while the run is active; no final RunRecord is saved. Every noncompliance, failed model/cap/deadline and failed cleanup stays failure. The temporary fixture is removed only after owned closes settle, with exact original root/marker identity; root should independently verify any retained fixture path if cleanup is false. Cleanup may exceed the response deadline.
